Is This Longtime Holt Restaurant About to Close?

Kristen MatthewsPublished: October 19, 2026
  • Share on Facebook
  • Share on Twitter
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:54
Instaread

There are has been a lot of recent change to the Greater Lansing restaurant scene lately.

This year alone, we've seen the closure of some long-time favorites. Places likes Coral Gables in East Lansing and Big Boy in Holt, among others, have all closed their doors after decades in business.

It looks like we may see another long-time favorite close its doors.

Delhi Cafe in Holt May Be Closing Soon

There is word that Delhi Cafe in Holt may be closing soon.

When Is Delhi Cafe's Reported Last Day?

According to Terence D., a member of the Lansing Foodies Facebook page, he had just finished a meal at Delhi Cafe on October 14 when he learned about the restaurant's impending closure. According to the post, the cafe's final day is allegedly October 23.

Other members of the Lansing Foodies group have chimed in in the comments, adding to the discussion about this tentative news. Lynn J. mentioned that the owners "said it was time. Their father owned the Golden Gate and when that closed, he built Delhi Cafe. They've been in business many years. They had a good run."

READ ALSO: Michigan’s Last Smokey Bones Suddenly Closes Without Warning

As of October 18, Delhi Cafe has not made any announcements on its social media pages or posted any signs on the restaurant's doors. The family restaurant has not yet responded to a request for comment.

If Delhi Cafe Family Restaurant is indeed closing its doors, it will surely be missed, judging by the huge outpouring of love in the comments on the Lansing Foodies post.

Delhi Cafe has been family-owned and operated in Holt since 1992, serving Greek favorites, delicious breakfasts, and American dishes.

Featured Local Savings

13 Lansing Restaurants That Locals Miss

Change is the one constant throughout life. So of course, Lansing has seen its fair share of restaurants close. However, there are some restaurants that some locals miss dearly. These are 13 restaurants that have closed through the years that Lansing locals miss.

Gallery Credit: Kristen Matthews

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Hot N Now — Holt

The only remaining Hot N Now is in Sturgis, MI.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Emil's — Lansing

Emil's was Lansing's oldest restaurant but finally closed in 2015. For a brief time, Emil's had a small spot in the food court at the Meridian Mall, but that has since closed.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Theio's — Lansing

Theio's was great because it was open 24 hours and offered breakfast all day. It was definitely a greasy spoon, but locals loved it. I still have a Theio's mug at home.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Clara's — Lansing

Clara's Restaurant was so charming with the train car. My favorite part was Sunday brunch. The spirit of Clara's train car lives on in Bobcat Bonnie's, the new restaurant that's taken over part of that space.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

DeLuca's — Lansing

Closed in 2022.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Bonnie's — Lansing

Locals loved the burgers here. But sadly, it's been closed for over a decade now.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Silver Dollar — Lansing

Formerly located on Michigan Avenue, this place was a longtime favorite.

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Brannigan Brothers — Lansing

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Claddagh Irish Pub — Lansing

David "Mad Dog" DeMarco

Demarco's — Lansing

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

The Dispatch — Lansing

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Houlihan's — Lansing

Photo Courtesy of Google Streetview

Mijo's Diner — Lansing

10 Restaurants That We Miss In Southwest Michigan

10 Restaurants that are no longer in Southwest Michigan that we would love to see return.

Gallery Credit: DaJzon Hughes

Photo by Bruce Bennett Getty Images

TGI Friday's

TGI Fridays was one that we were all sad to see go. They weren't jus taken from Southwest Michigan but basically the state as a whole since there is only one left in Southfield.

Photo by Scott Olson Getty Images

Bennigan's

Bennigan's is a restaurant that I only got to eat at a couple of times before it was taken from us way too early. The service was always great, and the food was consistent, that's really all you can ask for.

Google Streetview

Menna's Joint

Those of us that grew up in this area have most likely spent some late nights out partying on campus, at the movies, or simply just hanging with friends. If you weren't trying to wait in line at Two Fellas, the best bet was their competitor Menna's Joint right around the corner on Stadium. I could go for a Dub right now forreal!

Google Streetview

Cheeseburger Paradise

I think most people in this area can tell you that the building in this picture will always be memorable because of the tower. What I will say is, you can know how old someone is by asking them what they remember that tower as. If they don't say cheeseburger paradise, they're too young for you!

Google Streetview

Outback Steakhouse

All of our Outback steakhouses were taken away for subpar crab boil and seafood places because that was the most recent trend. Please bring back those juicy steaks and bloomin onions!

Google Streetview

Captain Luey's

Southwest Michigan knows that some of the best seafood in the area comes right here in Battle Creek. Captain Lueys was always certified for great seafood and service, they will be missed.

Google Streetview

Theo & Stacy's

Theo & Stacy's somewhat still lives as they sold both of their buildings to the Berries Pancake house owners. They have done a phenomenal job of providing great food and service while keeping a few of the T&S staples alive. It just doesn't quite have the same feel.

Google Streetview

Old Country Buffet

Southwest Michigan can tell you that 9/10 they were going to see tons of people they knew at Old Country Buffet after church service. It was almost as if it was mandatory to be there. They did have good food and some of the best buffet dessert ever.

Google Streetview

CiCi's Pizza

There's nothing that cures a day like pizza and what's better than a pizza buffet that is not only tasty but experimental? Also, those powdered sugar covered donuts were straight SLAPPERS.

Google Streetview

Ponderosa

Once again, another steakhouse that I would like to have back. This is easily my favorite steakhouse behind ocean prime and it would be a nice switch up from Texas Roadhouse.

Google Streetview

Brann's

There was nothing better than going to Celebration Cinema and then having dinner at Brann's! It was like the best day ever because of the nice movie theater and great food. Then if you were really lucky, you got a chance to go over to the mall as well. It was great food in the perfect location.
